title: Events alert — 2026-11-10
body:
• Today 14:30 Berlin / 08:30 ET — October CPI. Consensus (Reuters/Dow Jones): headline +0.3% m/m, core +0.2% m/m; no official y/y (Oct 2025 not collected; BofA interpolates ~3.8% / 2.7%). December hike ~75–78% priced — hot core compresses AI multiples, semis and neoclouds first; cool print is the relief valve.

• Tonight 23:00 Berlin / 17:00 ET — CoreWeave Q3: ~$3.54B revenue (+~159% YoY), loss ~$1.21/sh; options ±21%; stock $46–49, −49% in a month. Test is debt-funded backlog conversion — read-across NBIS/IREN.

• Wed Nov 12, call 14:00 Berlin / 08:00 ET — Nebius Q3: ~$906M revenue expected.

TSMC October revenue today: NT$586.9B, +59.7% YoY, a record — hardware demand intact. Nvidia stays Nov 17.

Sleeves: semis and infrastructure carry CPI + earnings risk tonight; power holds; 15% cash parked until 14:30.

Sources: web search 2026-11-10 (Reuters/Dow Jones previews, TipRanks, Business Insider, TSMC IR/Focus Taiwan).
